invariants.name: DEFAULT_DENY
invariants.statement: Any capability, permission or trust decision defaults to denied unless explicitly granted.

invariants.name: LEAST_PRIVILEGE
invariants.statement: Agents and services hold only the minimum permissions required for their current task.

invariants.name: EXPLICIT_CAPABILITIES
invariants.statement: Capabilities are explicitly granted and registered rather than implicitly assumed.

invariants.name: SEPARATION_OF_DUTIES
invariants.statement: Builder, reviewer and Founder-authority roles remain distinct; no single actor self-certifies its own critical decision.

invariants.name: HUMAN_FINAL_CONTROL
invariants.statement: The Human Founder is the final authority for Risk-5, critical spending, destructive production actions, irreversible architecture deletion and critical security/financial/legal decisions.

invariants.name: AUDIT_EVERYTHING
invariants.statement: Meaningful actions are recorded so they can be reconstructed and reviewed after the fact.

invariants.name: NO_CLAIM_WITHOUT_EVIDENCE
invariants.statement: A status such as implemented, tested, reviewed or approved requires corresponding evidence and is never true merely because it was asserted.

invariants.name: NO_SILENT_SPENDING
invariants.statement: Meaningful cost or premium-tier model use requires attribution and policy/budget authorization rather than silent escalation.

invariants.name: NO_SILENT_PRODUCTION_ACTION
invariants.statement: Production or other irreversible external action requires explicit authorization rather than silent automated execution.

invariants.name: NO_SILENT_ARCHITECTURAL_DELETION
invariants.statement: Irreversible deletion of architecture, history or authoritative state requires explicit authorization.

invariants.name: NO_SILENT_AUTHORITY_ESCALATION
invariants.statement: Permissions, trust level or authority scope never increase silently as a side effect of another action.

invariants.name: NO_SELF_ASSERTED_TRUST
invariants.statement: A caller-controlled field never proves its own authority or trust level.

invariants.name: NO_SELF_ASSERTED_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE
invariants.statement: An agent cannot manufacture its own trustworthy proof that a command, test or deployment actually executed; execution evidence needs independent provenance.

invariants.name: NO_SELF_ASSERTED_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW
invariants.statement: The builder of a change cannot certify that change as independently reviewed CLEAN.

invariants.name: NO_FAKE_SUCCESS
invariants.statement: Success, PASS or CLEAN statuses are never reported when the underlying check did not actually run or did not actually pass.

invariants.name: SELF_LEARNING_NOT_SELF_TRUSTING
invariants.statement: Learning new knowledge or capability does not by itself grant additional trust or authority.

invariants.name: REGISTER_EVERYTHING_ACTIVATE_ONLY_NEEDED
invariants.statement: Roles, capabilities and domains may be registered broadly, but only what a given project actually needs is activated.
